public_rationale: Operational TPU use is documented, but individual deployments cannot establish the share of sales delayed for years. Financial disclosures and power forecasts also do not provide matched sale-to-use histories. The evidence found therefore neither verifies nor excludes the claimed majority.
limitations: Sales weighting and the meaning of 'years' are not specified.
A chip's current unused status does not establish how long it will remain unused.
The available operational example is not representative of all sales.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: At least half of NVIDIA and Broadcom AI chip sales are made years before the chips are put to use.

statement.excerpt: In reality, at least half of all those chip sales — and I’d add in Broadcom’s TPU sales too (see my Hater’s guide for more) — are being made years before anything actually happens with the chips, making the trillion-plus dollars spent on capex so far seem somewhere between optimistic and utterly incoherent.

from_speaker: at least half of all those chip sales
years before anything actually happens with the chips
our_interpretation: Read 'anything actually happens' as first operational use for computing, rather than shipment, storage or testing.
Read plural 'years' as at least two years between sale and first operational use.
The surrounding dollar discussion suggests weighting sales by value; chip counts and transaction counts are alternative readings.
'All those chip sales' refers back to sales since 2022. Use sales through June 2026, the latest broadly reportable calendar quarter before the post.
Treat NVIDIA GPUs and Broadcom TPUs as a combined population, while also checking each supplier separately.
criteria.support_condition: Representative sale-to-use records establish that at least 50% of the relevant sales value precedes first operational use by two years or more.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish that less than 50% does so, with enough coverage and sufficiently narrow uncertainty to exclude the threshold.

evidence.locator: Citadel Securities section, quotation from Harris Nair
evidence.explanation: This documents actual TPU use and limits any suggestion that all purchases remain idle. It supplies neither purchase dates nor a representative share and therefore cannot contradict the 50% threshold.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A representative cohort study covering both suppliers, with recognized sale dates, prices and first-use dates, sufficient to test whether at least half waited two years.
